task_selection: Core first, then lexical overlap with target D text, then Task ID

occupations.title: Sales Managers
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: The product is explicitly described as an "AI-POWERED SALES CRM" and includes features for managers to plan the sales process, set sales goals, create sales forecasts, and analyze team performance [D:Freshsales:landing:1, D:Freshsales:features:14, D:Freshsales:features:15].

tasks.text: Direct and coordinate activities involving sales of manufactured products, services, commodities, real estate, or other subjects of sale.
Plan and direct staffing, training, and performance evaluations to develop and control sales and service programs.
Monitor customer preferences to determine focus of sales efforts.
Represent company at trade association meetings to promote products.

occupations.title: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: The software is designed for salespeople to "Sell smarter and close deals faster," grow their pipeline, automate sales sequences of emails and calls, and manage leads and deals [D:Freshsales:landing:1, D:Freshsales:features:4].

tasks.text: Identify prospective customers by using business directories, following leads from existing clients, participating in organizations and clubs, and attending trade shows and conferences.
Monitor market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales.
Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, keeping sales records, and filing expense account reports.
Prepare sales contracts and order forms.

occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.mapping: model-inferred from pack D (no review data)
occupations.rationale: Freshsales includes a "MARKETING AUTOMATION" suite to "run smart sales campaigns to generate more leads," segment audiences, and analyze visitor behavior for conversion rate optimization [D:Freshsales:landing:1, D:Freshsales:features:9, D:Freshsales:features:10].

tasks.text: Use sales forecasting or strategic planning to ensure the sale and profitability of products, lines, or services, analyzing business developments and monitoring market trends.
Recommend modifications to products, packaging, production processes, or other characteristics to improve the environmental soundness or sustainability of products.
Identify, develop, or evaluate marketing strategy, based on knowledge of establishment objectives, market characteristics, and cost and markup factors.
Direct the hiring, training, or performance evaluations of marketing or sales staff and oversee their daily activities.
